APPROVE

The extracted helpers keep the original order of checks and short-circuiting; the one change, recomputing `EnclosingSection(file, lines, i)` on each match instead of caching it, gives the same result because `i` is fixed for the call, and my estimate puts the method's cognitive complexity at about 13. That estimate counts only the code visible in the diff, and I haven't built the project.
